title: Structured library errors and public envelope

claims.text: LineageError stores a stable code and a deep-copied JSON diagnostic detail, initializing the exception with the code.
as_dict returns ok false with the code and, only when detail is not None, a deep-copied detail; error_payload returns that dict for the HTTP host.
JSONValue is a TypeAlias for the recursive None, bool, int, float, str, list and dict union used for diagnostic data.

decision.rule: Change here when the error code contract or the public error envelope needs to change.
decision.failure: An error payload omits the code, leaks a mutable detail reference, or includes detail when it must be absent.

questions.q: Where does LineageError detach its diagnostic detail?
Where should I change the public error envelope shape?
Where can I debug why an error response is missing its detail?
